0022600109.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-2, 12th in the West, fifth in the Southwest and 2 games back) are on a two-game losing streak as they visit the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, 9th in the West, third in the Southwest and 1 game back), who are riding a one-game win streak. Jayden Quaintance is out for San Antonio with a knee injury after surgery, and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and a game-time decision. Dallas is missing Cooper Flagg (shoulder sprain) and Dereck Lively II (foot surgery), and Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Kyrie Irving, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic are all day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 139-120 regular-season win in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
